dag_id.description: The dag_id of the DAG to trigger.
dag_id.title: Dag Id

wait_for_completion.description: Whether to wait for the triggered DAG to complete.
wait_for_completion.title: Wait For Completion

poke_interval.description: Interval in seconds to check the status of the triggered DAG.
poke_interval.title: Poke Interval

allowed_states.description: List of allowed states for the triggered DAG.
allowed_states.title: Allowed States

failed_states.description: List of failed states for the triggered DAG.
failed_states.title: Failed States

fail_when_dag_is_paused.description: Whether to fail the task if the triggered DAG is paused.
fail_when_dag_is_paused.title: Fail When Dag Is Paused

reset_dag_run.description: Whether to reset the triggered DAG run if it already exists.
reset_dag_run.title: Reset Dag Run

depends_on.description: Steps that must complete before this step runs

trigger_rule.description: Trigger rule for this step (default: all_success)
